description: An oil painting of a sleeping infant swaddled in white in a carved wooden rocking cradle, in a dim room with a sunlit window on the left. A side table holds a stack of old books with a small brass globe on top, and the book spines carry legible lettering that starts NATUR. Through the window is a smoky industrial skyline of tall chimneys and houses with lit windows. There is a scrawled signature at the bottom right, and the painting sits inside a plain white margin on every side rather than filling the image.
reason: Shows a baby in a cradle before a factory skyline, with books as a minor prop; nothing depicts the Brothers Grimm publishing their folk tales (for example, a storyteller or a fairy tale scene, or the book itself as the focus). A white margin surrounds the painting on all four sides, so it reads as a mat or border rather than an edge-to-edge painting.
